$comment: Managed patches against prebuilt dependencies. Applied before build and asserted by scripts/verify-patches.mjs, so a yarn install cannot silently drop them.

patches.reason: Upstream login page hardcodes /open-mercato.svg; the product must not ship the original brand asset path.
API merges code-defined custom fields over DB rows, so seeded English labels win over the translated database.
ListEmptyState never passed the illustration slot the shared EmptyState primitive supports, so every empty list was plain text.
Search no-results state rendered an icon circle instead of the brand illustration.
Widget rows used p-3 / space-y-1.5 / mt-2, giving ~90px per record; tightened spacing raises records per screen.
Widget rows used p-3 / space-y-1.5 / mt-2, giving ~90px per record; tightened spacing raises records per screen.
One entry for navigation configuration: settings section merge plus page-group collapse, both sourced from src/nav.
One entry for every change to widget.client.js: dashboard-date-locale-deals, dashboard-deal-status, dashboard-locale-init-deals, dashboard-density-new-deals
One entry for every change to widget.client.js: dashboard-date-locale-customers, dashboard-locale-init-customers
One entry for every change to AppShell.js: nav-aria-labels, sidebar-active-group, settings-sidebar-expanded, sidebar-footer-removed

Files compiled from the private mirror packages/** source of truth, stored in vendor/open-mercato/prebuilt (not dist/: git ignores dist). One installer, one marker per target, content guards per file.
ADR-006 A: validate the recipient against the adapter recipientFormat, compose chat messages without a fabricated externalEmail, and hand the stored provider-native recipient to the adapter (G7/G8).
Team-send policy A: team-visible channels are sendable by non-owners with per-send attribution; private channels stay owner-only.
The CRM rail replaces the group list, so the built-in nav search would filter an empty list; hide it when there are no groups.
A provider id already stored must complete delivery instead of failing the job and re-sending the message (round-31 drill produced 5 duplicate sends).

Stock AppShell renders the active destination without aria-current and keeps the aside width transition under prefers-reduced-motion; the retired rail had aria-current, so shipping stock as-is is an a11y regression.

A provider send whose outcome is unknown (transport failure, or the local commit failed after the provider accepted) must be marked unknown and never blindly retried; a stale attempt marker from a crashed worker is also surfaced for reconciliation instead of re-sending.

A missing or inactive channel throws before the outbound MessageChannelLink is located, leaving a queued/pending link in-flight forever. Mark the existing link failed (lastError channel_missing|channel_inactive), emit delivery_failed, flush and return failed; keep the throw only when no link exists.

createConnectedChannelRow never writes visibility, so tenant-scoped WhatsApp/Messenger channels keep user_id=null + visibility=private and sendAsUser rejects every sender. Set visibility=shared for channelScope=tenant on create and reconnect/heal; per-user channels keep their visibility.

P6-v2: a reply must reuse the inbound conversation even when its organization_id is null. Add org-scoped-then-tenant-only reads for the parent link/conversation and the conversation upsert, and look up ChannelThreadMapping by (external_conversation_id, tenant_id) — updating it in place — instead of inserting and hitting channel_thread_mappings_ext_conv_uq.
